The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 11151 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 15 July - the folder's feast day. Captioned Kirik and Iulitta and filed under Category:Quiricus and Julietta in icons; the child and his mother are commemorated together on this day and the folder's own display name is «Cyricus, son of Julitta», so the joint plate is its hero. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
